# Ayman Boujjar

> Full-Stack & Mobile Developer based in Casablanca, Morocco. Specializes in Laravel, React, React Native and Expo for production web and mobile applications. Also available for worldwide remote freelance and contract work.

## Who

- Name: Ayman Boujjar
- Primary title: Full-Stack & Mobile Developer
- Positioning: Freelance Developer
- Work model: Remote worldwide
- Location: Casablanca, Morocco
- Current affiliation: LionsGeek Association — Full Stack Developer (team contributor on LionsGeek deliveries; not founder/owner)
- Site: https://aymanboujjar.com/
- GitHub (public developer profile): https://github.com/aymanboujjar
- LinkedIn (professional profile): https://www.linkedin.com/in/aymanboujjar

## Capabilities

- Web applications with Laravel, React, Inertia, TypeScript, and Tailwind
- Cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android with React Native and Expo
- Backend APIs, third-party integrations, authentication, and notifications
- Real-time features and AI-powered application experiences (where project scope includes them)

## Award

- Ada Lovelace — LionsGeek team award project; Ayman created the 3D avatar and integrated Moroccan Darija into teammates’ parts. Prix Coup de Cœur Jury at [IN]VISIBLE Festival 2026 (XR4Heritage, Brussels). Shown separately from the project archive.

## Featured work

- LionsGeek Mobile — React Native / Expo app on the App Store and Google Play (iOS & Android)
- MyLionsGeek — Laravel + Inertia + React full-stack community platform
- Tilila — Laravel + React platform for CPD / 2M media initiatives
- YES Mobile, Casatourat, ISRAR, LionsGeek.ma, and other client projects
